div.div:
💡 AZ placement is a logical representation
• Actual AZ placement of pods/CronJobs is decided by the K8s scheduler
• App nodes are dynamically provisioned by Karpenter (starting from 0)
• Only the Call API is spread across multiple AZs for HA
• There is only one CronJob (weather-cron)
AZ-independent · one is enough

div.div:
💡 1 NAT Gateway (2a only) FinOps choice
• Works fine with a single NAT (shared by private subnets across AZs)
• Cost-first choice: saves about $43/month ↔ outbound traffic stops if 2a fails
• Production should use one NAT per AZ for redundancy (HA)
• Cost: single ≈ $43/month vs 2 (one per AZ) ≈ $86/month
(Seoul region hourly rate $0.059 x 730h · excludes data processing charges)

div.div:
💡 RDS Single-AZ (fixed to 2a) — FinOps choice
• Unlike pods, the DB's AZ is fixed at creation time (it doesn't move)
• Cost-first choice: $0 standby cost ↔ DB goes down if 2a fails
• Production should use Multi-AZ (2c standby with automatic failover)
